projects.name: ArIa-Roomba
projects.title: Edge Impulse
projects.description: A simple Roomba robot using Arduino Uno Q,  XRP controller, encoders and IMU for localization, mapping and Planning.  Egde impulse is used for classification and dirt heatmap generation.
projects.readme:
Records labelled vacuum audio clips from a **Seeed ReSpeaker Lite** (ESP32-S3) and saves them as `.wav` files ready for upload to **Edge Impulse**.

This demo showcases ARIA's core capabilities running live on the Arduino UNO Q:
highlights: 📐 Encoders & IMU — real-time wheel odometry and inertial measurement feeding the EKF pose estimator

highlights: 📷 100% Passive & Camera-Free: Zero optical cameras or audio microphones. Respects user privacy while maintaining spatial awareness.
🧱 Wall-Penetrating Motion Detection: Uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi CSI signal distortion to sense movement behind solid walls.
⚡ Battery & Solar Powered: Low-power architecture with TP4056 Type-C charging and an 80x40mm 5V solar panel.
🐱 Cyberpunk Cat Enclosure: Compact, cute, 3D-printable cat-themed handheld chassis designed in Autodesk Fusion 360.
Distance Estimation: Calculates physical attacker proximity using Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI).
